claims.claim: 急性高原病患病率在未习服人群中为 40% 至 90%（依海拔与上升速度而异）。
claims.sourceTitle: Acute high-altitude sickness
claims.supportQuote: Prevalence of AMS varies between 40% and 90%, depending on altitude and individual susceptibility in unacclimatised individuals
claims.applicability: 急性高原病为高原胸闷、心慌、气短最常见病因，其患病率以海拔与上升速度分层，是病因构成判断的流行病学依据。
claims.uncertainty: 患病率跨研究差异大，取决于研究场景、上升速度与习服程度；数值为综述汇总而非单一前瞻性队列的构成比。

claims.claim: 急性高原病患病率在被动升至 3000–3500 m 时约 25%–40%。
claims.sourceTitle: Acute high-altitude sickness
claims.supportQuote: whereas prevalence with passive ascent to 3000–3500 m is ∼25–40%
claims.applicability: 被动上升至中等海拔时急性高原病患病率较低，为高原症状病因构成提供分层参照。
claims.uncertainty: 为综述汇总值，随上升方式与个体易感性变化。

claims.claim: 高原脑水肿在海拔低于 4000 m 罕见，4200 至 5500 m 之间患病率估计为 0.5%–1%。
claims.sourceTitle: Acute high-altitude sickness
claims.supportQuote: HACE occurs rarely at altitudes <4000 m, and its prevalence between 4200 m and 5500 m is estimated to be 0.5–1%
claims.applicability: 高原脑水肿为致命但罕见的急性高原病，是意识改变、共济失调主诉的鉴别实体之一。
claims.uncertainty: 为综述的估计值，因疾病罕见缺乏系统性危险因素分析。

claims.claim: 高原肺水肿患病率在 ≥3 日攀登至 4000–5000 m 的一般登山人群中低于 0.2%，单日急升可达 7%。
claims.sourceTitle: Acute high-altitude sickness
claims.supportQuote: Its prevalence ranges from <0.2% in a general mountaineering population when climbing in ≥3 days to altitudes of 4000–5000 m, but as high as 7% with a single-day ascent
claims.applicability: 高原肺水肿是静息呼吸困难、咳粉红色泡沫痰主诉的鉴别实体，处置首选下撤。
claims.uncertainty: 患病率随上升速度与个体易感性变化大，为综述汇总数据。

claims.claim: 急性高原病预防以阶梯上升为基础，>2500–3000 m 后每晚睡眠海拔升高不超过 300–600 m，每 3–4 日安排休息日。
claims.sourceTitle: Acute high-altitude sickness
claims.supportQuote: With ascents >2500–3000 m, individuals should not increase their sleeping elevation by >300–600 m per night and should take a rest day every 3–4 days
claims.applicability: 阶梯上升与习服是高原反应预防的基石，任何预防性用药均不得替代该安排。
claims.uncertainty: 推荐主要源自观察性数据，仅一项前瞻性随机研究检验过具体上升速度。

claims.claim: 乙酰唑胺为急性高原病预防的一线药物，125 mg 对多数行程足够。
claims.sourceTitle: Acute high-altitude sickness
claims.supportQuote: Acetazolamide remains the mainstay of AMS prophylaxis. While there has been debate about the appropriate dosage for prophylaxis [ 117 ], the bulk of the evidence suggests 125 mg twice daily is sufficient for most climbs
claims.applicability: 乙酰唑胺是现行指南推荐的急性高原病预防药物；速效救心丸不在其中。
claims.uncertainty: 剂量存在争议，快速上升或极高海拔时 125 mg 每日两次可能不足。

claims.claim: 高原脑水肿应予地塞米松 8 mg 首剂后 4 mg 每 6 小时，直至下撤或症状消退。
claims.sourceTitle: Acute high-altitude sickness
claims.supportQuote: Dexamethasone should be administered by the oral, intramuscular or intravenous route at a dose of 8 mg initially followed by 4 mg every 6 h until the person has descended or symptoms have fully resolved
claims.applicability: 为高原脑水肿的药物治疗方案，属应下撤并呼救情形下的处置，而非留观或自行用药。
claims.uncertainty: 处置阈值来自高原医学共识与综述，非随机对照证据。

claims.claim: 高原脑水肿一旦出现神经系统症状即应立即下撤。
claims.sourceTitle: Acute high-altitude sickness
claims.supportQuote: The onset of neurological symptoms suggestive of HACE is an indication for immediate descent
claims.applicability: 意识改变、共济失调属应立即下撤并呼叫急救的情形，不宜先自行用药或继续上升。
claims.uncertainty: 为综述与指南共识的处置原则，非随机对照证据。

claims.claim: 高原肺水肿为低氧性肺血管收缩过强所致的非心源性肺水肿，右心导管测得肺动脉压均值 60（35–115）mmHg、肺楔压正常。
claims.sourceTitle: Acute high-altitude sickness
claims.supportQuote: mean (range) pulmonary artery pressures of 60 (35–115) mmHg, but normal pulmonary artery wedge pressures
claims.applicability: 低氧性肺血管收缩与右心后负荷升高是低压性低氧通向心肌缺血的机制环节之一，属机制层次而非临床事件层次。
claims.uncertainty: 数值来自高原现场右心导管研究，样本量小。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸疗效证据来自 41 项、共 6276 例冠心病患者的随机对照试验 meta 分析，心电图改善 RR 1.32（95%CI 1.26 至 1.38）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Forty-one trials involving 6276 patients were included in our analysis. Administration of suxiao jiuxin pill significantly improved electrocardiogram (ECG) results when compared with other therapies (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, and P < 0.001)
claims.applicability: 结局为心电图与症状等中间指标，人群为中国冠心病/心绞痛患者，未设海拔或低氧分层，仅支持在气滞血瘀型冠心病心绞痛人群中改善症状与心电图的较弱表述。
claims.uncertainty: 以中间指标为主，不能外推至高原场景或临床终点获益。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸 meta 分析的纳入研究多因缺乏双盲而 Jadad 评分低。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The majority of the included studies received low Jadad scores due to the lack of a double-blind design
claims.applicability: 纳入研究偏倚风险高，是该疗效证据确定性低的原因之一。
claims.uncertainty: 低 Jadad 评分反映报告质量，不直接等同于效应不存在。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸的不良反应以轻微头痛、头晕、面部潮红为主，与对照组的差异无统计学意义（RR 1.12，95%CI 0.50 至 2.51）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The most common symptoms were mild headache, dizziness, and facial flushing. Most of these symptoms resolved spontaneously. There was no significant difference in the adverse reaction rates between the treatment and the control groups (RR 1.12, 95% CI 0.50 to 2.51, and P = 0.785)
claims.applicability: 不良反应数据来自冠心病心绞痛人群，无高原场景人群的发生率。
claims.uncertainty: 多数研究未系统记录不良反应，发生率无可靠分母。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸 meta 分析未分析心血管死亡或药物相关并发症。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: In this study, we did not analyze cardiovascular death or drug-related complications
claims.applicability: 缺乏临床硬终点证据，其对预后的影响不能由症状与心电图改善推出。
claims.uncertainty: 未分析不等于无影响，但结论只能止于中间指标。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸 meta 分析纳入的全部研究均在中国开展。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: All of the included studies were conducted in China
claims.applicability: 全部研究在中国开展且未设海拔或低氧分层，高原场景的疗效无直接证据。
claims.uncertainty: 单一人群来源可能引入偏倚，且不覆盖高原暴露情境。

claims.claim: 离体人体动脉研究测得速效救心丸对氯化钾与 U46619 预收缩的内乳动脉产生完全舒张（99.4% 与 99.9%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill Induces Potent Relaxation and Inhibition on Contraction in Human Artery and the Mechanism
claims.supportQuote: SJP caused full relaxation in KCl- (99.4 ± 10.5%, n = 6) and U46619- (99.9 ± 5.6%, n = 6) contracted IMA
claims.applicability: 为离体人体动脉的药理机制证据，支持血管舒张方向，不等于高原人群临床结局获益。
claims.uncertainty: 离体器官浴实验，浓度与体内有效浓度关系不确定。

claims.claim: 高原三级医院急性冠脉综合征回顾性队列纳入 133 例患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Retrospective Analysis of the Epidemiological and Clinical Characteristics of Acute Coronary Syndrome in a Tertiary Hospital Located at High Altitude
claims.supportQuote: Among 133 ACS patients, 72.9% were male, with a mean age of 68.9 ± 13.9 years
claims.applicability: 提供高原城市急性冠脉综合征的样本特征，但为单中心回顾性、选择性样本。
claims.uncertainty: 无低海拔对照组，样本量小。

claims.claim: 该高原急性冠脉综合征队列中 STEMI 占 48.9%、NSTEMI 占 33.8%。
claims.sourceTitle: Retrospective Analysis of the Epidemiological and Clinical Characteristics of Acute Coronary Syndrome in a Tertiary Hospital Located at High Altitude
claims.supportQuote: ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) was the most frequent ACS type (48.9%), followed by non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI) (33.8%)
claims.applicability: 为高原城市急性冠脉综合征的亚型构成，属描述性数据。
claims.uncertainty: 回顾性、单中心，无平原对照。

claims.claim: 该高原急性冠脉综合征队列的院内死亡率为 2.3%。
claims.sourceTitle: Retrospective Analysis of the Epidemiological and Clinical Characteristics of Acute Coronary Syndrome in a Tertiary Hospital Located at High Altitude
claims.supportQuote: Mortality was low (2.3%)
claims.applicability: 为高原城市急性冠脉综合征的院内死亡率，属描述性数据。
claims.uncertainty: 死亡仅 1 例，统计功效有限。

claims.claim: 该高原急性冠脉综合征研究明确缺乏低海拔对照组，无法评价海拔对发生率与结局的影响。
claims.sourceTitle: Retrospective Analysis of the Epidemiological and Clinical Characteristics of Acute Coronary Syndrome in a Tertiary Hospital Located at High Altitude
claims.supportQuote: A key limitation is the absence of a comparison group from low-altitude regions
claims.applicability: 高原人群急性冠脉事件发生率相对平原的差异缺乏前瞻性对照数据。
claims.uncertainty: 为研究自身声明的局限，亦是发生率比较不可靠的原因。

claims.claim: 高原肺栓塞可发生于年轻、既往健康的迁入者（17 例，平均年龄 24.35 岁，均为男性）。
claims.sourceTitle: Clinical characteristics of pulmonary embolism at extremely high altitude: a single-center retrospective study
claims.supportQuote: The HA-Group comprised 17 individuals with a mean age of 24.35 ± 0.88 years, all of whom were males who had migrated from the plains to high-altitude regions
claims.applicability: 肺栓塞是高原胸痛、气短的鉴别实体之一，可发生于无基础病的年轻迁入者。
claims.uncertainty: 回顾性单中心、样本量小（17 例）。

claims.claim: 急性高原病、高原肺水肿、高原脑水肿、急性冠脉综合征与肺栓塞共享低氧背景却是不同的临床实体，症状可重叠但处置路径不同：急性高原病以头痛为必备症状，高原肺水肿与肺栓塞均可表现为胸痛气短且易混淆，急性冠脉综合征则以胸痛为主、需心电图与心肌损伤标志物评估。

supportingSources.supportQuote: The leading symptom is headache, which is required for the diagnosis of AMS

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Clinical characteristics of pulmonary embolism at extremely high altitude: a single-center retrospective study
supportingSources.supportQuote: the diagnosis of PE is easily confused with that of altitude-related diseases, such as HAPE

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Retrospective Analysis of the Epidemiological and Clinical Characteristics of Acute Coronary Syndrome in a Tertiary Hospital Located at High Altitude
supportingSources.supportQuote: ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) was the most frequent ACS type (48.9%)

claims.applicability: 为高原胸闷、心慌、气短人群的鉴别框架，各实体处置路径不同，不得因共享低氧背景而相互替换。
claims.uncertainty: 三个来源为不同疾病类别的独立证据，未检索到同时量化各实体构成比的前瞻性队列，故确定性低。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸的疗效证据以心电图、症状与血液流变学等中间指标为主，且全部研究在中国冠心病/心绞痛人群开展、未设海拔或低氧分层、未分析主要心血管事件；据此，该证据仅能支持在气滞血瘀型冠心病心绞痛人群中改善症状与心电图这一较弱表述，不能外推至高原场景的预防或自救，亦不能由血黏度与血脂改善推出临床终点获益。
claims.method: 将四条直接证据合并为一条推理链：CLM-010 给出结局类型（心电图 RR 1.32，中间指标）与样本（41 项、6276 例）；CLM-011 给出纳入研究多因缺乏双盲而 Jadad 评分低；CLM-013 给出未分析心血管死亡；CLM-014 给出全部研究在中国开展（无海拔分层）。由中间指标＋高偏倚风险＋无硬终点＋无海拔分层，推出结论的可达范围仅限中国冠心病心绞痛人群的症状与心电图改善，任何超出该范围的命题均缺一跳。
claims.assumptions: 假设 meta 分析对结局与偏倚风险的报告如实反映原始试验；假设中国冠心病心绞痛人群与高原暴露人群在药效上不可无依据等同。
claims.sensitivity: 若存在未纳入 meta 分析的高原现场研究或海拔分层亚组，该结论的可达范围将相应扩展；但本次检索未发现此类研究。结论对 CLM-014 这一前提敏感。
claims.applicability: 此推导界定速效救心丸证据能支持到哪一步，不进入临床实践要点。
claims.uncertainty: 推导每一步均为对既有证据的合并解读，非新增测量。
